verdict.rationale: Solid's own README says it has full SSR with streaming and progressive hydration to reach interactivity quickly. It lists streaming SSR, Suspense and concurrent rendering as built-in features, and supports Node, Deno and Cloudflare Worker server runtimes. One community remark that Suspense should be avoided is general criticism, not a concrete failure of streaming, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of streaming APIs and behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of perceived-load gains from streaming.
